title: Keeping Shielded Data-Driven Controllers Safe Under System Evolution via Model Consistency
abstract: arXiv:2611.24428v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: Cyber-physical systems (CPS) increasingly contain data-driven controllers, which raise safety concerns given their black-box nature. A common mitigation is to enforce system safety via a shield around the controller, which restricts the inputs based on assumptions about the physical system. However, these assumptions are usually fixed and may become invalid as the system evolves (during development or due to component degradation), possibly leading to unsafe behavior. We address this limitation in a model-driven approach that treats both the data-driven controller and safety shield as first-class models that are integrated into a virtual single underlying model (V-SUM) alongside system models. We describe system evolution as changes in the associated models, such that consistency checking yields a continuous assessment of safety guarantees. translated_title: 通过模型一致性在系统演化过程中保持带屏蔽数据驱动控制器的安全性
translated_abstract: 信息物理系统（CPS）日益包含数据驱动的控制器，由于其黑箱特性，这引发了安全性问题。一种常见的缓解措施是在控制器周围设置安全屏蔽来保证系统安全，该屏蔽基于对物理系统的假设来限制输入。然而，这些假设通常是固定的，随着系统演化（在开发过程中或由于组件退化），假设可能会失效，进而导致不安全行为。我们在一种模型驱动的方法中解决了这一局限性，该方法将数据驱动控制器和安全屏蔽视为一等模型，与系统模型一起集成到虚拟单一底层模型（V-SUM）中。我们将系统演化描述为相关模型的变化，从而通过一致性检查实现对安全保证的持续评估。在不一致的情况下，一致性保持规则会自动更新模型并……
tldr: 本文提出一种模型驱动方法，将数据驱动控制器和安全屏蔽与系统模型集成到虚拟单一底层模型（V-SUM）中，通过一致性检查和一致性保持规则，在系统演化过程中持续保障带屏蔽控制器的安全性。
en_tdlr: This paper proposes a model-driven approach that integrates data-driven controllers and safety shields with system models into a virtual single underlying model (V-SUM), using consistency checking and consistency-preservation rules to continuously maintain safety guarantees under system evolution.
